<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to a Suzuki‑type cross‑coupling, which disconnects the target into a vinyl bromide (or iodide) bearing the methyl ester, cyclopropyl and trimethylsilyl groups, and an aryl boronic acid (phenyl‑boronic acid). This reaction breaks an aryl halide and a boronic acid and forms a new C‑C single bond, matching the desired one‑step synthesis.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide", "boronic acid"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C single bonds"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
